2.name: Brute Force
2.overview: With Gotham's eyes glued to Rupert Thorne's trial, the Batman protects the streets from the crime boss' retribution and gun-crazed lieutenant: Eddie Nygma aka The Riddler!

2.name: Rocket's Red Glare
2.overview: After a series of daring attacks on Triad Industries, the Batman must track down and stop the vengeful rocketeer who is responsible, by any means necessary, before their vendetta results in the loss of innocent life! However, as the Dark Knight Detective unravels the mystery, he discovers shocking revelations!

2.name: Deep Cover
2.overview: With Rupert Thorne missing and his replacement, Eddie Nygma (The Riddler) now wreaking havoc on Gotham, brutal street violence and brazen robberies escalate and the GCPD is spread too thin to slow it down. To get intel on Thorne's whereabouts and background on his new capo, Nygma, the Batman goes undercover in Blackgate prison in the guise of Matches Malone!

2.name: The Devil's Due
2.overview: A murder scene with a bloody bat symbol spells trouble for the Batman. Thanks to Hattie Tetch's smear campaign, the Dark Knight detective faces more public scrutiny than ever before. Determined to clear his name, the Batman discovers a fanatical bat cult led by a charismatic prophet, the Mad Monk.

2.name: The Spectral Hand
2.overview: Disgraced Detective Jim Corrigan volunteers for a prison experiment to redeem himself, but the result is far more horrifying than anyone including the Batman could have imagined.

2.name: Sudden Fear
2.overview: A series of mysterious student deaths at Gotham University draws Harley Quinn out of hiding. When her investigation converges with the Batman's, the two former adversaries strike an alliance to take down the immediate threat- the Scarecrow!

2.name: Her Dark Reflection
2.overview: After gunning down an ex-cop, Eddie "The Riddler" Nygma partners with a mysterious woman named Thorn. Their crime-riddled love affair turns Gotham upside down, forcing the Batman's hand.

2.name: Zero Hour
2.overview: As the Batman resumes his search for Rupert Thorne, his investigation intersects with that of Carrie Kelley, an amateur detective calling herself "The Crime Smasher"! Together, they team up to take down Gotham's underworld fixer, Mr. Zero!

2.name: Dead Before Dawn
2.overview: The Joker publicly announces Mayor Jessop's death sentence. As Gotham panics, the GCPD scrambles to protect the mayor while the Batman hunts down the Joker. Will their joint efforts be enough to stop what's coming?

2.name: The Laughing Death
2.overview: It's Judgement Day in Gotham when a contagion spreads across the city, turning citizens into homicidal maniacs. As survivors cower in fear, the Batman's allies mobilize to save whoever is left while the Dark Knight Detective finally faces his ultimate foe, The Joker!

overview: به شهر گاتهام خوش آمدید، جایی که تعداد فاسدها از افراد خوب بیشتر است، مجرمان بیداد می کنند و شهروندان قانونمند در حالت ترس دائمی زندگی می کنند. بروس وین اجتماعی ثروتمند که در آتش تراژدی جعل شده است به چیزی بیشتر و کمتر از انسان تبدیل می شود - بتمن. جنگ صلیبی تک نفره او برای عدالت، متحدان غیرمنتظره ای را در GCPD و شهرداری جذب می کند، اما اقدامات قهرمانانه او عواقب مرگبار و غیرقابل پیش بینی ایجاد می کند.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Follow the fearsome vigilante in his first year. Forged in the fire of tragedy, billionaire Bruce Wayne becomes something both more and less than human—the Batman. Night after night, against overwhelming odds, he wages his relentless one-man war on crime.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The Batman and his allies rally together to dismantle Rupert Thorne's criminal enterprise. But dethroning a reigning crime boss comes at a high price.

title: Batman: Caped Crusader
